description:
AERO V1 is a collaborative cycling-performance artefact by Lead Designer Q888 and Lead Engineer Ed. It reduces drag through aesthetic superiority, disciplined belief, and a willingness to explain a £230 sticker with a completely straight face. Physical protection remains exactly zero.

Ten early prototypes carried the complete blue velocity swoosh. Field review concluded that the additional 0.00888 Cd advantage demanded Tour de France concentration, precise karmic alignment, and the ability to remember that confidence is not protective equipment. The 50-unit public edition therefore removes the separate swoosh while preserving the essential condition of being More Aero. Ten have already entered service or been gifted; 40 remain available for civilian deployment.

Riders who remain professionally committed to dangerous flex may commission a one-of-one personal Full-Swoosh specification. The £300 custom upgrade adds the velocity swoosh and one tiny personal element of choice—a symbol, initial, miniature object, or similarly micro-aerodynamic intervention agreed before production. The approved design is made once and is not repeated for another rider. Please allow up to approximately 30 days for personal design, proof approval, aerodynamic testing, and delivery.

This is not a silent licensing arrangement. AERO V1 is a collaborative project, and every payment received for either configuration is divided equally between Q888 and Ed.

whyThisMatters:
The missing swoosh is not concealed production trivia; it is now part of the artwork's honest history. Accident became safety protocol, safety protocol became an edition, and the edition preserved the collaboration that made the object possible.

Choose the public V1 to remain responsibly More Aero. Choose the custom override to become Dangerously Flex. In both cases, the designers split reality—and the revenue—equally.
